profiles.notes: 2026/2027 direct secondary entry. Published Tanzanian ACSEE scores and programme subjects use the local system.

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Choose two principal passes from History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language, French, Arabic, Fine Arts, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Agriculture, Computer Science or Nutrition. O-level English must also be at least C. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 301, UD093

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Give principal History at grade D or higher and another principal pass in English Language, Kiswahili, Economics, Geography, Fine Arts, French or Arabic. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 301, UD094

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Use principal passes in Chemistry and Physics. Both subjects must also be at least C at O level. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 301, UD095

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Use principal Chemistry and Biology and O-level credits in both. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 302, UD096

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Choose two principal passes from History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language, French, Arabic, Fine Arts, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Advanced Mathematics, Agriculture, Computer Science or Nutrition. If none is Advanced Mathematics, Economics or Commerce, O-level Basic Mathematics must be C or higher. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 302, UD097

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Choose two principal passes from History, Geography, Kiswahili, English Language, French, Arabic, Fine Arts, Economics, Commerce, Accountancy or Advanced Mathematics. Show five O-level passes including three credits. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 303, UD099

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: The guide lists two principal passes from Advanced Mathematics, Biology, Geography or Computer Studies and a Physics grade of at least D. The Physics grade level should be confirmed with UDSM. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 303, UD100

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Use principal Geography and one principal pass in Economics, Chemistry, Biology, Agriculture, History or Literature. O-level Geography also needs a credit. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 304, UD101

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Use principal Geography with Biology, Economics, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Kiswahili or History. Also provide an O-level Geography credit. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 304, UD102

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Choose two principal passes from Commerce, Computer Science, Economics, Business Studies, Mathematics, Accounting, arts or science. Give a subsidiary Advanced Mathematics pass or an O-level Basic Mathematics credit. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 304, UD103

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Combine principal Biology with Physics, Chemistry, Agriculture, Nutrition, Geography, Physical Education, Fine Art, Economics or Advanced Mathematics. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 304, UD104

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Present a principal pass in Biology and another in Chemistry, Geography, Physics, Computer Science or Mathematics. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 305, UD105

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Earn principal C or higher in Chemistry and Biology and D or higher in a third A-level subject. O-level Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Mathematics each need credits. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 305, UD106

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Provide two principal passes, including one from Advanced Mathematics, Economics, Business Studies, Physics or Computer Science. If Advanced Mathematics is absent, provide a subsidiary pass in Basic Applied Mathematics or Advanced Mathematics and grade B or above in O-level Mathematics. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 305, UD108

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Present two principal passes in social sciences or arts. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 306, UD110

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Choose two principal passes from English, English Literature and Kiswahili. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 306, UD111

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Earn grade C or higher in two subjects. One must be Kiswahili. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 306, UD114

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Give principal passes of at least C in Chemistry and Biology and at least D in A-level Physics. The TCU row also asks for credits in Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Mathematics without specifying the level in that clause. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 6 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 306, UD115

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Choose Geography as one principal pass and a related subject as the other. Also provide an O-level Geography credit. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 306, UD116

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Use Physics as one principal pass and a related subject as the other. Give C or above in O-level Mathematics and Chemistry. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 306, UD117

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Present two principal passes, one in Advanced Mathematics, Economics, Business Studies, Physics or Computer Science. If Advanced Mathematics is absent, provide an A-level Basic Applied Mathematics subsidiary pass and at least B in O-level Mathematics. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 307, UD118

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Combine Biology with one principal pass from Physics, Chemistry, Food and Human Nutrition, Agriculture, Mathematics, Geography or Economics. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 307, UD119

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Use two principal passes in any A-level subjects. Add either an A-level Mathematics subsidiary pass or O-level Mathematics C. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 307, UD120

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Use two principal passes in any A-level subjects. If there is no principal or subsidiary pass in A-level Mathematics, show O-level Mathematics at C or above. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 4.0 ACSEE points.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 307, UD121
